title: African Wild Dogs: Where to See Them in Tanzania
excerpt: African wild dogs are among the most endangered carnivores in Africa. Where in Tanzania you have the best chance to see them.
body:
## Social hunters

Wild dogs live in packs and hunt together, with a high success rate.

## Endangered

Disease, habitat loss and conflict with people have reduced numbers.

## Where

- [Nyerere National Park](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/).
- [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/).
- [Mkomazi](/blog/mkomazi-rhino-sanctuary/) (reintroduction programme).
- Occasionally in the Serengeti ecosystem.

## Chances

Packs range widely, so sightings are never guaranteed.

## Also called

Painted wolves or painted dogs.
